name: Kaii Bangou ~20XX~
original_name: 怪異番号~20✕✕(ニーマルバツバツ)~
source:
Japan, 2005 — In a mid-sized city, the protagonist is living an ordinary middle school life when they hear a strange rumor:
“There’s a public restroom somewhere in town with a phone number that can tell you if your crush will return your feelings.”

It’s known as the “Love Fortune Phone.”

To find out their compatibility with their crush, Kamidani,
the protagonist sets out into the night in search of that mysterious number.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4154100/20/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
2005年，日本——在一座中等规模的城市里，过着平凡初中生活的主角听闻了一则离奇的传言：
“镇上某处的公共厕所里写着一串电话号码，打过去就能知道暗恋的人会不会回应你的心意。”

人们将其称为“恋爱占卜电话”。

为了测算自己与暗恋对象神谷的缘分，
主角走入夜色之中，踏上了寻找那串神秘号码的旅途。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4154100/20/]Steam[/url]]
